examples.chinese: A：你今天早上有課嗎？ B：我今天早上沒有課。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ jīntiān zǎoshang yǒu kè ma? B: Wǒ jīntiān zǎoshang méi yǒu kè.
examples.english: A: Do you have class this morning? B: I don’t have class this morning.

examples.chinese: B:我今天早上沒有課？ A:你今天早上有課嗎？
examples.pinyin: B: Wǒ jīntiān zǎoshang méiyǒu kè? A: Nǐ jīntiān zǎoshang yǒu kè ma?
examples.english: B: I don't have class this morning? A: Do you have class this morning?

examples.chinese: 我早上沒有課，九點去圖書館。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshang méi yǒu kè, jiǔ diǎn qù túshūguǎn.
examples.english: I don’t have class in the morning. I am going to the library at 9:00.

examples.chinese: 我爸爸每天早上都喝一杯咖啡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba měi tiān zǎoshang dōu hē yì bēi kāfēi.
examples.english: My father drinks a cup of coffee every morning.

examples.chinese: 我每天早上七點去學校運動。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang qī diǎn qù xuéxiào yùndòng.
examples.english: I go to school to exercise at 7:00 every morning.

examples.chinese: 我平常早上七點起床，八點吃早飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng, bā diǎn chī zǎofàn.
examples.english: I usually get up at seven and have breakfast at eight in the morning.

examples.chinese: 我每天早上八點半到學校。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang bā diǎn bàn dào xuéxiào.
examples.english: I arrive at school at 8:30 every morning.

examples.chinese: 我明天早上九點要到機場。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn yào dào jīchǎng.
examples.english: I need to arrive at the airport at nine o'clock tomorrow morning.

examples.chinese: 學校的圖書館早上八點開，晚上九點關。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de túshūguǎn zǎoshang bā diǎn kāi, wǎnshang jiǔ diǎn guān.
examples.english: The school library opens at 8 a.m. and closes at 9 p.m.

examples.chinese: 他每天早上去上班，晚上去上課，真辛苦！
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zǎoshang qù shàngbān, wǎnshang qù shàngkè, zhēn xīnkǔ!
examples.english: He goes to work every morning and goes to class in the evening; it's really tough!

examples.chinese: 我明天早上十點會在學校門口等你。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān zǎoshang shí diǎn huì zài xuéxiào ménkǒu děng nǐ.
examples.english: I will wait for you at the school gate at ten o'clock tomorrow morning.

examples.chinese: 每天早上公園裡都有很多人在運動，非常熱鬧。
examples.pinyin: Měitiān zǎoshang gōngyuán lǐ dōu yǒu hěn duō rén zài yùndòng, fēicháng rènao.
examples.english: Every morning in the park there are many people exercising, it is very lively.

examples.chinese: 我每個星期天早上都跟家人去教堂。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi ge xīngqītiān zǎoshang dōu gēn jiārén qù jiàotáng.
examples.english: Every Sunday morning I go to church with my family.

examples.chinese: 爸爸每天早上一起床就看報紙。
examples.pinyin: Bàba měitiān zǎoshang yì qǐchuáng jiù kàn bàozhǐ.
examples.english: Every morning as soon as Dad gets out of bed, he reads the newspaper.

examples.chinese: 早上開車去上班時，忽然有隻狗從路口跑出來，把我嚇了一跳。
examples.pinyin: Zǎoshang kāichē qù shàngbān shí, hūrán yǒu zhī gǒu cóng lùkǒu pǎo chūlái, bǎ wǒ xià le yí tiào.
examples.english: When I was driving to work this morning, a dog suddenly ran out from the intersection and gave me a shock.

examples.chinese:
這次的電腦展集合了各國有名的牌子，很值得參觀。
老師要帶我們去參觀博物館，明天早上九點在校門口集合。
examples.pinyin:
Zhè cì de diànnǎo zhǎn jíhé le gè guó yǒumíng de páizi, hěn zhídé cānguān.
Lǎoshī yào dài wǒmen qù cānguān bówùguǎn, míngtiān zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn zài xiàoménkǒu jíhé.
examples.english:
This computer exhibition gathered famous brands from various countries and is well worth visiting.
The teacher is taking us to visit the museum; we will gather at the school gate at 9 a.m. tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 我每天早上一醒來就去刷牙、洗臉，然後去附近國小的操場跑步。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang yì xǐnglái jiù qù shuāyá, xǐliǎn, ránhòu qù fùjìn guóxiǎo de cāochǎng pǎobù.
examples.english: Every morning as soon as I wake up, I go brush my teeth and wash my face, and then I go running on the playground of the nearby elementary school.

items.wordHook: 早(early) + 上(on top) → the early sun on top of the horizon: 早上(morning).

examples.chinese: 這些水果，有的不甜，我不想吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē shuǐguǒ, yǒude bù tián, wǒ bù xiǎng chī.
examples.english: Some of this fruit are not sweet, I do not want to eat them.

examples.chinese: 越來越多人選擇上網購物，有的是為了節省時間，有的是因為比價很方便。
examples.pinyin: Yuè lái yuè duō rén xuǎnzé shàngwǎng gòuwù, yǒude shì wèile jiéshěng shíjiān, yǒude shì yīnwèi bǐjià hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.english: More and more people choose to shop online; some do so to save time, and some because comparing prices is very convenient.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，孩子出生滿一個月的時候，有的父母會請客，慶祝孩子滿月。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, háizi chūshēng mǎn yí ge yuè de shíhou, yǒude fùmǔ huì qǐngkè, qìngzhù háizi mǎnyuè.
examples.english: In Taiwan, when a child is one month old, some parents will treat guests to celebrate the baby's full month.

examples.chinese: 現在突然下起了大雨，我們的計畫被破壞了，恐怕今天所有的活動都必須重新安排。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ, wǒmen de jìhuà bèi pòhuài le, kǒngpà jīntiān suǒyǒu de huódòng dōu bìxū chóngxīn ānpái.
examples.english: Now it has suddenly started raining heavily, and our plans have been ruined; I'm afraid all of today's activities must be rearranged anew.

examples.chinese: 在所有的同事中，我覺得小周最好相處了。他的性格開朗、說話幽默，還常主動幫忙，跟他相處起來很愉快、很自在。
examples.pinyin: Zài suǒyǒu de tóngshì zhōng, wǒ juéde Xiǎo Zhōu zuì hǎo xiāngchǔ le. Tā de xìnggé kāilǎng, shuōhuà yōumò, hái cháng zhǔdòng bāngmáng, gēn tā xiāngchǔ qǐlái hěn yúkuài, hěn zìzài.
examples.english: Among all my colleagues, I think Xiao Zhou is the easiest to get along with. He has a cheerful personality, speaks humorously, and often offers help proactively; getting along with him is very pleasant and relaxed.

examples.chinese: 有的人一喝牛奶就拉肚子，可能是因為身體吸收不料牛奶的營養。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu de rén yì hē niúnǎi jiù lādùzi, kěnéng shì yīnwèi shēntǐ xīshōu bù liǎo niúnǎi de yíngyǎng.
examples.english: Some people get diarrhea as soon as they drink milk; it may be because their body cannot absorb the nutrition in milk.

examples.chinese: 他把所有的錢都給了女朋友，直到女朋友被警察抓了，才知道自己被騙。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ suǒyǒu de qián dōu gěi le nǚpéngyǒu, zhídào nǚpéngyǒu bèi jǐngchá zhuā le, cái zhīdào zìjǐ bèi piàn.
examples.english: He gave all his money to his girlfriend, and only when his girlfriend was caught by the police did he realize he had been cheated.

examples.chinese: 我覺得有的舊東西很不錯，有的新東西也很有趣，我很喜歡看新車、新衣服，可是因為我的錢不多，所以我不常買。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde yǒude jiù dōngxi hěn búcuò, yǒude xīn dōngxi yě hěn yǒuqù, wǒ hěn xǐhuān kàn xīn chē, xīn yīfu, kěshì yīnwèi wǒ de qián bù duō, suǒyǐ wǒ bù cháng mǎi.
examples.english: I think some old stuff is good and some new ones are interesting. I like to check the new car, new clothes out, but I do not have much money, so I don’t buy them often.

items.wordHook: 有(have) + 的(of) → the ones that exist: 'some' of a group.

examples.chinese: 明天我有空，我想去買皮包。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ yǒu kòng, wǒ xiǎng qù mǎi píbāo.
examples.english: Tomorrow I have free time; I want to go buy a wallet.

examples.chinese: 百貨公司裡有很多衣服、鞋子和皮包，都是最新的，所以很多年輕女生喜歡到百貨公司去，漂亮的、流行的衣服，她們都想穿穿看。
examples.pinyin: Bǎihuògōngsī lǐ yǒu hěn duō yīfu, xiézi hé píbāo, dōu shì zuì xīn de, suǒyǐ hěn duō niánqīng nǚshēng xǐhuān dào bǎihuògōngsī qù, piàoliang de, liúxíng de yīfu, tāmen dōu xiǎng chuānchuān kàn.
examples.english: Clothes, shoes and purses in department stores are all the latest; therefore, many young ladies like to go there and try on both beautiful and trendy items.

examples.chinese: 那三家商店都賣相同牌子的皮包，我們最好先比個價，再決定買哪一家的。
examples.pinyin: Nà sān jiā shāngdiàn dōu mài xiāngtóng páizi de píbāo, wǒmen zuìhǎo xiān bǐ ge jià, zài juédìng mǎi nǎ yì jiā de.
examples.english: Those three stores all sell handbags of the same brand; we'd better compare prices first, then decide which one to buy from.

examples.chinese:
付錢的時候，他從皮包裡抽出一張信用卡交給店員。
他參加百貨公司的活動，抽到一台價格六萬元的平板電腦， 真是太幸運了！
examples.pinyin:
Fù qián de shíhou, tā cóng píbāo lǐ chōu chū yī zhāng xìnyòngkǎ jiāo gěi diànyuán.
Tā cānjiā bǎihuò gōngsī de huódòng, chōu dào yī tái jiàgé liù wàn yuán de píngbǎn diànnǎo, zhēn shì tài xìngyùn le!
examples.english:
When paying, he took out a credit card from his wallet and handed it to the clerk.
He participated in a department store event and drew a tablet computer worth 60,000 yuan; he was really so lucky!

examples.chinese:
我們公司打算今年跟美國合作，生產名牌皮包。
除夕那天，大家都忙著打掃、貼春聯，只有弟弟很不合作，什麼事都不做。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒmen gōngsī dǎsuàn jīnnián gēn Měiguó hézuò, shēngchǎn míngpái píbāo.
Chúxī nà tiān, dàjiā dōu mángzhe dǎsǎo, tiē chūnlián, zhǐyǒu dìdi hěn bù hézuò, shénme shì dōu bù zuò.
examples.english:
Our company plans to cooperate with the US this year to produce brand-name leather bags.
On New Year's Eve, everyone was busy cleaning and putting up spring couplets; only my younger brother was very uncooperative and didn't do anything.

items.wordHook: Leather (皮) wrap (包) → a wallet is a leather wrap for your money.

examples.chinese: 媽媽告訴我，不要忘記去超級市場買飲料。
examples.pinyin: Māma gàosu wǒ, bùyào wàngjì qù chāojí shìchǎng mǎi yǐnliào.
examples.english: Mom told me not to forget to go to the supermarket to buy drinks.

examples.chinese: 我很擔心他，請他去看醫生，也告訴他要聽醫生的話，不要忘記多喝水、多休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn dānxīn tā, qǐng tā qù kàn yīshēng, yě gàosu tā yào tīng yīshēng de huà, bú yào wàngjì duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxí.
examples.english: I’m so worried about him, so I told him to go see a doctor. I also told him to listen to the doctor, to drink plenty of water and get some rest.

examples.chinese: 有個騙子吃完了麵，假裝忘記帶錢包，騙老闆要回家拿錢，一離開就沒回來了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu ge piànzi chī wán le miàn, jiǎzhuāng wàngjì dài qiánbāo, piàn lǎobǎn yào huí jiā ná qián, yī líkāi jiù méi huílái le.
examples.english: A cheater finished eating noodles and pretended to have forgotten his wallet; he tricked the owner into letting him go home to get money, and as soon as he left, he never came back.

items.wordHook: 忘(forget) + 記(remember) → forgetting to remember: 忘記(to forget).

examples.chinese: 旅行的目的除了看風景，還可以了解那個地方的文化特色。
examples.pinyin: Lǚxíng de mùdì chúle kàn fēngjǐng, hái kěyǐ liǎojiě nàge dìfāng de wénhuà tèsè.
examples.english: The purpose of travel, besides seeing the scenery, is also to understand the cultural features of that place.

examples.chinese: 台灣的夜市很有特色，除了有各式各樣的小吃，還有不少好玩的遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de yèshì hěn yǒu tèsè, chúle yǒu gèshìgèyàng de xiǎochī, hái yǒu bùshǎo hǎowán de yóuxì.
examples.english: Taiwan's night markets are very distinctive; besides having various snacks, there are also quite a few fun games.

examples.chinese: 台灣的夜市很有特色，吸引了不少外國遊客。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de yèshì hěn yǒu tèsè, xīyǐn le bùshǎo wàiguó yóukè.
examples.english: Taiwan's night markets are very distinctive and have attracted many foreign tourists.

examples.chinese: 店員把這台咖啡機的特色說明得非常清楚，聽了他的說明以後，大家都很感興趣。
examples.pinyin: Diànyuán bǎ zhè tái kāfēijī de tèsè shuōmíng de fēicháng qīngchǔ, tīngle tā de shuōmíng yǐhòu, dàjiā dōu hěn gǎn xìngqù.
examples.english: The clerk explained the features of this coffee machine very clearly. After hearing his explanation, everyone was very interested.

examples.chinese: 為了參加同事的婚禮，我打算當天穿上很有特色的中國傳統服裝。
examples.pinyin: Wèile cānjiā tóngshì de hūnlǐ, wǒ dǎsuàn dāngtiān chuān shàng hěn yǒu tèsè de Zhōngguó chuántǒng fúzhuāng.
examples.english: In order to attend my colleague's wedding, I plan to wear very distinctive traditional Chinese clothing on that day.

examples.chinese: 這堂課的內容跟文化有關，所以老師把教學重心放在介紹各國的文化特色。
examples.pinyin: Zhè táng kè de nèiróng gēn wénhuà yǒuguān, suǒyǐ lǎoshī bǎ jiàoxué zhòngxīn fàng zài jièshào gè guó de wénhuà tèsè.
examples.english: The content of this class is related to culture, so the teacher put the teaching focus on introducing the cultural characteristics of various countries.

examples.chinese: 這個國家公園的服務中心提供遊客簡介，介紹公園的特色和有名的景點。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guójiā gōngyuán de fúwù zhōngxīn tígōng yóukè jiǎnjiè, jièshào gōngyuán de tèsè hé yǒumíng de jǐngdiǎn.
examples.english: This national park's service center provides visitors with a brief introduction, introducing the park's features and famous scenic spots.

examples.chinese: 小張喜歡閱讀法國的文學作品，透過這些作品，讓他了解了法國文化的特色。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng xǐhuan yuèdú Fǎguó de wénxué zuòpǐn, tòuguò zhèxiē zuòpǐn, ràng tā liǎojiě le Fǎguó wénhuà de tèsè.
examples.english: Xiao Zhang likes to read French literary works; through these works, he has come to understand the characteristics of French culture.

examples.chinese: 如想通過那家企業的面試，就得先熟悉他們的產品特色與銷售方式。
examples.pinyin: Rú xiǎng tōngguò nà jiā qǐyè de miànshì, jiù děi xiān shúxī tāmen de chǎnpǐn tèsè yǔ xiāoshòu fāngshì.
examples.english: If you want to pass that company's interview, you must first be familiar with their product features and sales methods.

examples.chinese: 他每次出國，都會幫朋友代購許多具有當地特色的商品。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi cì chūguó, dōu huì bāng péngyǒu dàigòu xǔduō jùyǒu dāngdì tèsè de shāngpǐn.
examples.english: Every time he goes abroad, he buys on behalf of friends many products with local characteristics.

examples.chinese: 觀光客都說日本四季的景色都很有特色，有機會我要親自去體驗一下。
examples.pinyin: Guānguāngkè dōu shuō Rìběn sìjì de jǐngsè dōu hěn yǒu tèsè, yǒu jīhuì wǒ yào qīnzì qù tǐyàn yíxià.
examples.english: Tourists all say that Japan's scenery in all four seasons is very distinctive; if I have the chance, I want to experience it for myself.

examples.chinese: 旗袍是華人最有特色的服裝之一，我想訂一套屬於我的旗袍。
examples.pinyin: Qípáo shì Huárén zuì yǒu tèsè de fúzhuāng zhī yī, wǒ xiǎng dìng yī tào shǔyú wǒ de qípáo.
examples.english: The cheongsam is one of the most distinctive costumes of the Chinese people; I want to order a cheongsam of my own.

examples.chinese: 最近賣的新飲料很有特色，所以光臨我們店的客人越來越多。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn mài de xīn yǐnliào hěn yǒu tèsè, suǒyǐ guānglín wǒmen diàn de kèrén yuè lái yuè duō.
examples.english: The new drinks sold recently are very distinctive, so more and more customers are honoring our shop with their presence.

examples.chinese: 這個背包在設計上沒什麼特色，只是印了某位明星隨手畫的圖，沒想到就要賣上萬元，實在有點兒誇張。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bēibāo zài shèjì shàng méi shénme tèsè, zhǐshì yìnle mǒu wèi míngxīng suíshǒu huà de tú, méi xiǎngdào jiù yào mài shàng wàn yuán, shízài yǒudiǎnr kuāzhāng.
examples.english: This backpack has nothing distinctive in its design; it just has a picture casually drawn by some celebrity printed on it. I never expected it to sell for over ten thousand dollars—that's really a bit outrageous.

examples.chinese: 那只鑽石戒指的設計極有特色，很適合當作婚戒(wedding ring)。
examples.pinyin: Nà zhī zuànshí jièzhǐ de shèjì jí yǒu tèsè, hěn shìhé dāngzuò hūnjiè.
examples.english: The design of that diamond ring is extremely distinctive; it is very suitable to serve as a wedding ring.

examples.chinese: 這家工廠使用的大型機械全都是淺綠色的，看起來很有特色。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng shǐyòng de dàxíng jīxiè quán dōu shì qiǎnlǜsè de, kàn qǐlái hěn yǒu tèsè.
examples.english: The large machinery used in this factory is all light green, and looks very distinctive.

examples.chinese: 我家的客廳當中擺了一套皮沙發。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā de kètīng dāngzhōng bǎi le yí tào pí shāfā.
examples.english: In the middle of my living room, a leather sofa set is placed.

examples.chinese: 如果只注意別人的缺點，就永遠看不到他們的優點了。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhǐ zhùyì biérén de quēdiǎn, jiù yǒngyuǎn kàn bù dào tāmen de yōudiǎn le.
examples.english: If you only pay attention to others' shortcomings, you will never see their strengths.

examples.chinese: A:我到底該怎麼做才能讓老闆滿意？ B:你太驕傲、個性太急， 做事也不夠仔細。總之， 先把自己的缺點改掉吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ dàodǐ gāi zěnme zuò cái néng ràng lǎobǎn mǎnyì? B: Nǐ tài jiāo'ào, gèxìng tài jí, zuòshì yě bù gòu zǐxì. Zǒngzhī, xiān bǎ zìjǐ de quēdiǎn gǎi diào ba.
examples.english: A: What on earth should I do to satisfy the boss? B: You are too arrogant, your personality is too impatient, and you are not careful enough in doing things. In short, first change your shortcomings.

examples.chinese:
張先生常幫太太買菜、洗衣服， 要是比太太早下班，還會把晚餐做好，真體貼。
我同學很體貼父母，經常煮飯、 做家事，幫了父母不少忙。
examples.pinyin:
Zhāng xiānsheng cháng bāng tàitai mǎi cài, xǐ yīfu, yàoshi bǐ tàitai zǎo xiàbān, hái huì bǎ wǎncān zuò hǎo, zhēn tǐtiē.
Wǒ tóngxué hěn tǐtiē fùmǔ, jīngcháng zhǔfàn, zuò jiāshì, bāng le fùmǔ bùshǎo máng.
examples.english:
Mr. Zhang often helps his wife buy groceries and wash clothes; if he gets off work earlier than his wife, he also makes dinner—he is truly considerate.
My classmate is very considerate of his parents; he often cooks and does housework, helping his parents a lot.

examples.chinese:
包小姐的眼光很好，一看就知道那件黃色外套的品質最好。
妹妹：我希望將來找個又聰明又有錢 ，而且很體貼我的男朋友。 姊姊：妳的眼光太高了，恐怕找不到。
examples.pinyin:
Bāo xiǎojiě de yǎnguāng hěn hǎo, yí kàn jiù zhīdào nà jiàn huángsè wàitào de pǐnzhí zuì hǎo.
Mèimei: Wǒ xīwàng jiānglái zhǎo ge yòu cōngmíng yòu yǒu qián, érqiě hěn tǐtiē wǒ de nánpéngyou. Jiějie: Nǐ de yǎnguāng tài gāo le, kǒngpà zhǎo bú dào.
examples.english:
Miss Bao has a good eye; she can tell at a glance that the quality of that yellow coat is the best.
Younger sister: I hope to find a boyfriend in the future who is smart, rich, and very considerate of me. Older sister: Your standards are too high; I'm afraid you won't find one.

examples.chinese: 他雖然年紀小，但是對人有禮貌，也很體貼父母，是個乖孩子。
examples.pinyin: Tā suīrán niánjì xiǎo, dànshì duì rén yǒu lǐmào, yě hěn tǐtiē fùmǔ, shì ge guāi háizi.
examples.english: Although he is young, he is polite to people and also very considerate of his parents; he is a well-behaved child.

examples.chinese:
我跟弟弟是雙胞胎，很多人都以為我是他，這樣的誤會我早就習慣了。
A:何小姐只是我的鄰居，不是我的女朋友，大家都誤會了。 B:你對她很體貼，不但常送她上班，還常陪她逛街，大家對你們有誤會也是正常的。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ gēn dìdi shì shuāngbāotāi, hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi wǒ shì tā, zhèyàng de wùhuì wǒ zǎo jiù xíguàn le.
A: Hé xiǎojiě zhǐshì wǒ de línjū, bùshì wǒ de nǚpéngyǒu, dàjiā dōu wùhuì le. B: Nǐ duì tā hěn tǐtiē, bùdàn cháng sòng tā shàngbān, hái cháng péi tā guàngjiē, dàjiā duì nǐmen yǒu wùhuì yě shì zhèngcháng de.
examples.english:
My younger brother and I are twins; many people think I am him, and I've long been used to this kind of misunderstanding.
A: Miss He is just my neighbor, not my girlfriend; everyone has misunderstood. B: You are very considerate to her; not only do you often take her to work, but you also often accompany her shopping. It's normal for everyone to have a misunderstanding about you two.

examples.chinese: 石經理對員工很兇，回家後卻能表現出溫柔的一面，非常體貼太太。
examples.pinyin: Shí jīnglǐ duì yuángōng hěn xiōng, huíjiā hòu què néng biǎoxiàn chū wēnróu de yí miàn, fēicháng tǐtiē tàitai.
examples.english: Manager Shi is very fierce to employees, but after going home he can show a gentle aspect and is very considerate of his wife.

examples.chinese: A:我對何小姐是真心的，為什麼她一直不肯接受呢？ B:你應該更關心她、更體貼她，讓她知道你是真心愛她的。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ duì Hé xiǎojiě shì zhēnxīn de, wèishénme tā yìzhí bù kěn jiēshòu ne? B: Nǐ yīnggāi gèng guānxīn tā, gèng tǐtiē tā, ràng tā zhīdào nǐ shì zhēnxīn ài tā de.
examples.english: A: I am sincere toward Miss He; why does she keep refusing to accept me? B: You should care about her more and be more considerate of her, so she knows you truly love her.

examples.chinese: 老謝溫柔體貼、聰明英俊，符合我結婚對象的條件，因此我答應嫁給他。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo Xiè wēnróu tǐtiē, cōngmíng yīngjùn, fúhé wǒ jiéhūn duìxiàng de tiáojiàn, yīncǐ wǒ dāyìng jià gěi tā.
examples.english: Old Xie is gentle and considerate, smart and handsome, and meets the conditions for my marriage partner; therefore, I agreed to marry him.

items.wordHook: Combining 體(body) and 貼(stick): 體貼 means considerate, thoughtful.

examples.chinese: 結婚之前，那對情侶認真規劃了未來的生活，沒想到結婚一個月之後就離婚了。
examples.pinyin: Jiéhūn zhīqián, nà duì qínglǚ rènzhēn guīhuà le wèilái de shēnghuó, méi xiǎngdào jiéhūn yí ge yuè zhīhòu jiù líhūn le.
examples.english: Before getting married, that couple carefully planned their future life; unexpectedly, they divorced just one month after getting married.

examples.chinese: 在意外的發生原因沒查清楚之前，別隨便冤枉任何人。
examples.pinyin: Zài yìwài de fāshēng yuányīn méi chá qīngchu zhīqián, bié suíbiàn yuānwang rènhé rén.
examples.english: Before the cause of the accident is clearly investigated, don't wrongly accuse anyone casually.

examples.chinese: 在法律及法院之前，每個人都是平等的。
examples.pinyin: Zài fǎlǜ jí fǎyuàn zhīqián, měi ge rén dōu shì píngděng de.
examples.english: Before the law and the court, everyone is equal.

examples.chinese: 在吃湯麵之前淋上點兒芝麻油，吃起來味道更好。
examples.pinyin: Zài chī tāngmiàn zhīqián lín shàng diǎnr zhīmayóu, chī qǐlái wèidào gèng hǎo.
examples.english: Before eating noodle soup, drizzle on a little sesame oil; it tastes even better.

items.wordHook: Combining 之(of) and 前(front): 之前 means before, prior to.

examples.chinese: 花蓮那幾家旅館的雙人客房都客滿了，我們還是訂民宿吧。
examples.pinyin: Huālián nà jǐ jiā lǚguǎn de shuāngrén kèfáng dōu kèmǎn le, wǒmen háishì dìng mínsù ba.
examples.english: The double guest rooms at those hotels in Hualien are all fully booked; we'd better book a homestay instead.

examples.chinese: 爸爸為了迎接伯父回臺灣過節，把客房打掃得很乾淨。
examples.pinyin: Bàba wèile yíngjiē bófù huí Táiwān guòjié, bǎ kèfáng dǎsǎo de hěn gānjìng.
examples.english: In order to welcome Uncle back to Taiwan for the holiday, Dad cleaned the guest room very clean.

examples.chinese: 我們吃完早餐，就動身去舞蹈教室練習舞蹈。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen chī wán zǎocān, jiù dòngshēn qù wǔdǎo jiàoshì liànxí wǔdǎo.
examples.english: After we finished breakfast, we set off for the dance studio to practice dance.

examples.chinese: 明天一大早要動身出國旅遊，所以我在睡前先把鬧鐘調好。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān yīdàzǎo yào dòngshēn chūguó lǚyóu, suǒyǐ wǒ zài shuì qián xiān bǎ nàozhōng tiáo hǎo.
examples.english: We need to set off early tomorrow morning to travel abroad, so before going to bed I'll first adjust the alarm clock.

examples.chinese: 這部電腦的鍵盤有幾個鍵壞了，我得找人修理它。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànnǎo de jiànpán yǒu jǐ ge jiàn huài le, wǒ děi zhǎo rén xiūlǐ tā.
examples.english: Several keys on this computer's keyboard are broken; I need to find someone to repair it.

examples.chinese: 那家公司的鍵盤常出問題，我再傻也不會跟他們購買。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngsī de jiànpán cháng chū wèntí, wǒ zài shǎ yě bú huì gēn tāmen gòumǎi.
examples.english: That company's keyboards often have problems; no matter how foolish I am, I wouldn't buy from them.

items.wordHook: 也(also) + 許(allow) → it may also be allowed: 也許(maybe).
a 力(strength) shoves a coin into the 口(mouth) slot → 加(add to).
Combining 及(and) and 格(form): 及格 means pass.
Speaking earnest words of truthful 言(speech) to 成(complete) a promise proves someone is truly 誠(honest).
With a strained 𠂊(bound hand), a porter carries a heavy sack of 貝(sea shell) coins bearing the 負(load).
